dict.string: Lets the agent read and add events, only when you turn on these tools. What it reads is sent to the AI model you chose.
Lets the agent find people in your contacts, only when you turn on this tool. What it finds is sent to the AI model you chose.
Lets the agent read, add and complete reminders, only when you turn on these tools. What it reads is sent to the AI model you chose.
Connects to the LLM, MCP, speech-to-text and text-to-speech servers you configure on your local network.
The microphone is used to hear what you say to the agent.
Apple speech recognition turns your speech into text when it is the selected speech-to-text provider.
